newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Flores set to take helm at finance min.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Flores set to take helm at finance min.

text.p: Marco Flores, an independent Ecuadorean congressman, on Monday said his inauguration as the country's finance minister would take place Thursday.
"I have accepted the president's proposal and the (inauguration) ceremony is set for Thursday afternoon," Flores told journalists.
President Fabian Alarcon asked Flores to head the finance ministry last week, after Carlos Davalos said in June he would step down from the post, citing personal reasons, government sources said.
Alarcon is expected to name Flores finance minister when he returns later this week from a trip to Bolivia.
Flores said his priorities when in office would be to introduce tax reforms and control public spending.
"We will focus on public expenditure, especially in the areas of education, health and housing, and an important reform of the customs services," he said.
Flores, who is an adviser to Alarcon, recently proposed that the country's foreign reserves be used to cover part of the budget deficit.
